notes.title: Patch v1.2.0.2
notes.content:
Patch notes:

Changed slide duration from 5s to 8s.

Bosses in the final stage must be defeated in succession for Hard and Very Hard Difficulty.

Every death decreases the player's passive damage by 1%.

Skill points can now be restored by killing 10 enemies.

Decreased difficulty promotion kill requirement.

Changed ancile damage reduction from 70% to 50%.

Entering boss fight no longer replenish health and stamina.

Successful dodge with iFrame dash now gives the following:

Restores 4 stamina points.
0 stamina consumption for 1.5s.
Player passive damage increase by 2%(stacks indefinitely, resets when you get hit.)




Manual Update v1.2.0.2
